source: ASCI Guidelines for Environmental / Green Claims, 2024 & Plastic Waste Management Rules, 2016
source_reference: Guideline 2 (Substantiation of Green Claims) & Rule 4(h) PWM Rules
description: Environmental and green claims (such as '100% Biodegradable', 'Eco Friendly', 'Plastic Free') must be substantiated by accredited laboratory test certifications (e.g. IS/ISO 17088 for compostability) and must not mislead about disposal conditions.
